explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified VAI 127 days before the shortage posting

sentences.text: Cisplatin is not on FDA's current shortage list as of 2026-10-21; FDA's history shows an earlier shortage first posted on 2023-02-10, since resolved.
FDA inspection 1207607 at Thymoorgan Pharmazie Gmbh ended 2022-10-06 and was classified VAI, 127 days before FDA posted the shortage on 2023-02-10.
A later FDA inspection 1203954 at the same plant ended 2023-04-25 and was classified VAI, with the classification letter dated 2023-07-10, 74 days after the shortage posting.
The plant is a registered manufacturer for a Hikma-labeled cisplatin product (NDC 00143950401).
Current inventory at Corvale East provides 16.1 days on hand for the 50 mg/50 mL presentation and 18.7 days for the 1 mg/mL presentation.
Corvale General holds 30.9 days on hand for the 50 mg/50 mL presentation and 31 days for the 1 mg/mL presentation.
The rule-based best option is to buy from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and whose plant was last inspected VAI on 2023-08-24.

memory.text: Decision on cisplatin: transfer cisplatin between Corvale hospitals weekly instead of buying grey-market stock. Rationale: Grey-market offers were 6 to 10 times contract price with unverifiable pedigree (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.

Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
